regions.name: The Crossroads
regions.description: Four roads meet under a leaning gallows. Someone has nailed a hand-drawn map to the post; three of the four roads have been scratched out.

shop.name: Mother Ash
shop.greeting: An old woman sits on the milestone with a blanket of corked bottles. She does not ask where you are going.

regions.name: Ashen Marsh
regions.description: Fog, iron, and things that breathe under the water. The reeds are grey with ash and they lean away from you as you pass.

shop.name: The Drowned Library
shop.greeting: A punt is moored in the reeds, loaded with books in oilcloth. Nobody is aboard, and the prices are chalked on the hull.

regions.name: The Burned Mill
regions.description: The wheel still turns, though the river dried out a generation ago. Bandits have carved tally marks into the doorframe; the last row is unfinished.

shop.name: Gritt the Fence
shop.greeting: A man with too many knives leans in the doorway. Everything on his rack came off somebody.

regions.name: Hollow Barrow
regions.description: A grass-covered mound with its mouth pried open. The air inside is colder than the night and tastes of old coins.

regions.name: Gravewood
regions.description: Trees grown through old war graves. Webbing hangs between the trunks in sheets, and something up there is patient.

regions.name: The Drowned Chapel
regions.description: Pews float in black water up to your chest. The altar candles are lit and nobody has been here for two hundred years.

regions.name: Obsidian Vault
regions.description: A stair of black glass descending into warmth. Every step you take is answered, far below, by something much heavier.

regions.name: Hall of the Mummy King
regions.description: A hall of painted pillars, swept clean. At the far end a figure in gold leaf sits waiting, and it has been told your name.
